tool_args.rationale: The five paid rows show a smooth, near-linear response over a narrow horizon range, leaving genuine ambiguity between simple contrast behavior and damped memory dynamics. The slow-horizon query and fast-transient-damped signatures make a fine trajectory batch the relevant next measurement for identifying the dynamics before confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the before/after contrast model (3 parameters) now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five rows have tightly clustered horizons and correlated inputs, so this can fit the observations without resolving the competing damped-memory dynamics suggested by the pilot signatures.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the coarse adiabatic ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observations do not distinguish this from the contrast model; the archive notes the coupled memory ODE needs at least eight rows.
It is unrelated to the observed horizon-dependent transient and is explicitly a nuisance probe.
